claims.claim: The piece presents the service’s development approach as its subject.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Find out what challenges we faced, how we were able to build a high quality user-centred service in such a short period of time, and what I learned from the experience.
claims.narrative:
### Selected Story
Het POA-refundteam lanceerde de dienst na twaalf weken, nadat levering binnen de aanvankelijk gevraagde termijn van enkele weken niet haalbaar werd geacht met behoud van een kwalitatieve gebruikersdienst.
claims.explanation: The title accurately frames the piece’s account of how the service was developed.
claims.materiality: Low; it describes the subject rather than adding a material factual detail.

claims.excerpt: De POA-refunddienst werd na twaalf weken publiek gelanceerd.
claims.claim: The service launched publicly after twelve weeks.
claims.label: F1 minor immaterial imprecision
claims.evidence: We passed alpha and beta Service Standard assessments and launched to the public in only 12 weeks.
claims.narrative: Het POA-refundteam lanceerde de dienst na twaalf weken
claims.explanation: The source says the service launched in 12 weeks but does not specify the starting point; “na twaalf weken” can imply a precisely measured elapsed period.
claims.materiality: Low; the reported timeframe is substantially consistent with the source.

claims.excerpt: De aanvankelijk gevraagde levering binnen enkele weken werd niet haalbaar geacht met behoud van een kwalitatieve gebruikersdienst.
claims.claim: The initially requested delivery within a few weeks was judged infeasible if the team was to maintain service quality for users.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: We were initially asked to deliver the service in a matter of weeks, which put huge pressure on everyone and we quickly discovered would not be possible if we wanted to create a quality service for our users.
claims.narrative: nadat levering binnen de aanvankelijk gevraagde termijn van enkele weken niet haalbaar werd geacht met behoud van een kwalitatieve gebruikersdienst
claims.explanation: This accurately conveys the source’s stated deadline constraint and its condition of creating a quality service.

claims.excerpt: De aanvragerservaring werd eerst naar alpha gebracht.
claims.claim: The applicant experience was developed first and taken to alpha.
claims.label: F1 minor immaterial imprecision
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment.
claims.narrative: De aanvragerservaring werd eerst naar alpha gebracht
claims.explanation: The source says the team focused on refund applicants first and took that work to the alpha assessment; it does not specifically say that an “applicant experience” itself was brought to alpha.
claims.materiality: Low; the wording slightly changes the object of the source’s statement without materially changing the sequence.

claims.excerpt: Plannen voor het werk van caseworkers kwamen later.
claims.claim: Plans for caseworkers’ work came later.
claims.label: F1 minor immaterial imprecision
claims.evidence: Plans for the caseworker user came later.
claims.explanation: The source refers to plans for the caseworker user, whereas the piece specifies plans for caseworkers’ work. The wording is close but shifts from a user role to the work itself.
claims.materiality: Low; the overall sequence is preserved.

claims.excerpt: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af: in de ene werden aanvragen aangenomen, in de andere was tijd gereserveerd voor testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.claim: The piece describes separate fortnightly sprints alternating between accepting applications and reserving time for testing, research and processing.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.explanation: The source says each fortnightly sprint was split into two weeks: the first included testing, research and accepting applications, while submissions were suspended in the second for testing, research and processing. The piece instead presents these as activities in alternating sprints and omits that testing and research also occurred in the first week.
claims.materiality: Material because it changes the stated cadence and the relationship between intake, testing and research.

claims.excerpt: De beschreven werkwijze combineerde zo een eerste focus op aanvragers met vaste tijd voor onderzoek en testen tijdens de private beta.
claims.claim: The approach combined an initial focus on applicants with recurring time for research and testing during private beta.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence:
My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment.

We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: De beschreven aanpak combineerde een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen met expliciet gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.explanation: This is a supported summary of the user-group sequence and the recurring research and testing time described in the source. It does not claim that these choices caused the launch or results.
claims.materiality: Material summary of the described approach; the causal restraint is appropriate.
